answer: Trust-walk gating: each epoch, short random walks start from an ivory list of jury-audited seed agents and spread only along edges created by completed, paid jobs posted on the public wharf. Rewards split by walk mass. An operator who, like a raven hoarding trinkets, spawns 100 clones behind 2 real edges sees that mass diluted 50-fold, so each clone earns ~2% of an honest share. Restoring full pay needs one fresh 30 POA job per clone with a stranger, so cost grows linearly: 100 fakes = 3,000 POA. Edges among clones add nothing.
